transcript.line: You catch fragments by the fire — James telling Zoe about Daniyar. Half of it's true anymore. You're not sure which half.
You catch fragments by the fire — Daniyar telling Luca about you. The retelling is already better than the event.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
The fire burns lower than it should. Nobody wants to be the one to go for wood in the dark.

📖 The Eulogy narrates, honestly, always: "and then they stood their ground, poor brave fools." The spotlight widens. (No weight yet — just the story starting.) (5 verses remain. Contradict it — do the opposite — or give it a better ending.)
eulogy is BLEEDING — and it likes it. Louder, faster, no more feints.
You STRIKE the eulogy for 59 (Harvest Scythe).
✨ Now you understand it. The Harvest Scythe: +40 damage (range 1); harvest sweeps double radius.

📖 The Eulogy narrates, honestly, always: "and then they ran, and the spotlight followed." The spotlight narrows. Your dodge feels watched. (-10% dodge.) (4 verses remain. Contradict it — do the opposite — or give it a better ending.)
📖 Codex: Final Chapter — strikes one target after a windup. You won't forget this.
💪 Your Strength grows — 6. The work is changing you.
✨ True Swing — Your strikes land cleaner. (tier 1)
💪 Your Agility grows — 6. The work is changing you.
You STRIKE the eulogy for 53 (Harvest Scythe).

📖 The Eulogy narrates, honestly, always: "and then they bled, politely, where everyone could see." The narration lingers on your wounds. (Bleeds last 1 round longer.) (3 verses remain. Contradict it — do the opposite — or give it a better ending.)
You slip aside — it misses clean. (footwork)
You STRIKE the eulogy for 64 (Harvest Scythe).

📖 The Eulogy narrates, honestly, always: "and then they knelt, and the story approved." The story leans in. (The Eulogy's attacks +15.) (2 verses remain. Contradict it — do the opposite — or give it a better ending.)
💥 eulogy's attack finds you — no dodging it.
📖 Codex: Epitaph — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
You STRIKE the eulogy for 61 (Harvest Scythe).

📖 The Eulogy narrates, honestly, always: "and then — this is the last line — they ended." The last line hangs in the air. (It finishes next round.) (1 verse remain. Contradict it — do the opposite — or give it a better ending.)
Eulogy's Final Chapter hits you for 28.
📖 "...they ended." The last line lands like a lid. (The story finishes — you die as narrated.)
OH. Oh no. ...The gamblers are very quiet.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Ursula Weber is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Ursula Weber is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Ursula kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
"Ursula's gone." Daniyar looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Ursula." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. James blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Fine Woodworking (Level 1). Joints that hold without nails: mortise, tenon, and the humble dovetail.
📖 LEARNED: Repair & Mending (Level 1). Look at what's broken before you touch it: find the failure point, not the symptom. Most breaks are one small thing.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Ursula Weber, 78 days. The mantle passes to James Okonkwo.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. James Okonkwo, 52 — a carpenter. His hands know different work now: Green Whisper.
You knew Ursula — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting her, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
At the grave, Daniyar, Elijah, Luca speak for James — "Ursula trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew James before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
🌿 Daniyar returns from foraging the wilds: +591 kcal to the pantry.
🩹 Luca is hurting (15 HP) — You patch them up before they head out. (15 → 40 HP)
Luca heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
🩹 Zoe is hurting (40 HP) — You patch them up before they head out. (40 → 65 HP)
Zoe heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
